container: Automation will reshape work by taking over repetitive tasks while creating demand for new skills and services. The transition will not affect every worker equally. Some industries may lose jobs quickly while others expand gradually. Governments, businesses, and schools must prepare people through affordable training, career guidance, and stronger safety nets. Employers can redesign roles so technology supports human judgment rather than replacing it. Workers will need curiosity, adaptability, and lifelong learning. With thoughtful planning, automation can improve productivity and create meaningful opportunities. Without it, it may deepen inequality and insecurity. The future depends on choices.
